title.en: Electric 10 Series does not print spare sizes
title.zh: 电动10系列没有印配件尺寸

description.en: Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump prints 15 kW, 21 m³/h and 23 MPa, and no delivery-pipe diameter, piston OD or seal kit. Electric 15 is a different page and does print 100–125 mm.
description.zh: 电动10系列混凝土泵印了 15 kW、21 m³/h 和 23 MPa，没有输送管内径、活塞外径或密封套件。电动15是另一页，并且印了 100–125 mm。

h1.en: Electric 10 Series, spare sizes not printed
h1.zh: 电动10系列，未印配件尺寸

directAnswer.en: Electric 10 Series is a compact electric pump made in Xingtai. The sheet identifies the machine and leaves pipe, piston and seal sizes blank. Those blanks are missing fields. They are not filled by Electric 15 or Electric 20.
directAnswer.zh: 电动10系列是邢台制造的紧凑型电动泵。参数页写明了机器，把管子、活塞和密封尺寸留空。这些空格是缺字段。不能用电动15或电动20去填。

body.en: Model Electric 10 Series. Motor 15 kW. Output 21 m³/h. Maximum outlet pressure 23 MPa. Hopper 0.1 m³. Horizontal distance 25 m. Aggregate 2 cm and below. Size 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm. Weight 400 kg. No vertical-distance cell is in this list. No delivery-pipe diameter is in this list.
body.zh: 型号 Electric 10 Series。电机 15 kW。输送量 21 m³/h。最大出口压力 23 MPa。料斗 0.1 m³。水平距离 25 m。骨料 2 cm 及以下。外形 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm。重量 400 kg。这份清单里没有垂直距离格。也没有输送管内径。

heading.en: Nearby pages that must stay separate

body.en: Electric 15 prints 15 kW, output 8–10 m³/h, and delivery pipe 100–125 mm. Electric 20 prints 22 kW and delivery pipe 80 mm. Wear-part pages list piston and seal sizes without naming Electric 10 Series. B500S-83D is another compact page, at 7.5 kW, with a hose cell that says Standard.
body.zh: 电动15印 15 kW、输送量 8–10 m³/h、输送管 100–125 mm。电动20印 22 kW、输送管 80 mm。易损件页列出活塞和密封尺寸，但没有点名电动10系列。B500S-83D 是另一台紧凑机，7.5 kW，胶管格写“标准”。

body.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Name Electric 10 Series. State that pipe DN, piston OD and seal kit are not printed. Do not attach Electric 15's 100–125 mm.
body.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明电动10系列。写明管径、活塞外径和密封套件都没有印出。不要附上电动15的 100–125 mm。

question.en: Is Electric 10 Series the same page as Electric 15?
question.zh: 电动10系列和电动15是同一页吗？

answer.en: No. Output is 21 m³/h on Electric 10 Series and 8–10 m³/h on Electric 15. Only Electric 15 prints a pipe diameter.
answer.zh: 不是。电动10系列的输送量是 21 m³/h，电动15是 8–10 m³/h。只有电动15印了管径。

answer.en: No. It is the horizontal pumping-distance cell.
answer.zh: 不是。它是水平输送距离格。

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。

answer.en: A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank.
answer.zh: 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。

label.en: Email or WhatsApp the Xingtai factory
label.zh: 邮件或 WhatsApp 联系邢台工厂
